eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 2:51 PM on AUG 30, 2021 Effective until 2:51 PM AUG 31, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Plumas County Sheriffs Office with an evacuation warning for the communities of East of Crocker Mountain toward Reconnaissance Peak Beckwourth Genesee Road at 23N53 north to 28N01 due to a wildfire. Make preparations to evacuate. If you have special needs you may want to evacuate now. If you have large animals you should make arrangements to move them immediately. If the situation changes, more alerts may be sent with new information. To view your evacuation zone, go to community.zonehaven.com.
